paragraphs.text: Angel's Keep or Angel Keep was a castle fortress built by Xarl in the swampy mountains of Wolf's Hackle , part of Golthonor , on the Dominarian continent of Corondor .

Angel's Keep was Archmage Xarl Angel-Keeper ’s tower in the Wolf's Hackle, granted to Xarl by Warlord Mandek Ironfist of the Iron Kingdom during the Time of Legends , thousands of years ago. The fallen angel Trine was imprisoned there, and the keep was greatly damaged when Trine escaped after Xarl's death.
It is unknown if the keep was rebuilt, or if it was fully abandoned and has since crumbled into ruin.
